about: The Large-image planner's figures for the target rows (and the design's 5333 x 3333 6x) at the three caps, under the tests' override (BXF_AVAILABLE, 'bxf' without a table) and the fail-closed default (tier 3), both Brownian caches, as engine/banded_plan.plan_banded gives them now (BANDED_PROVEN_MP lifted): wave 2's terms and wave 3's refit. Sizes and GiB only; the plan package's sizing script (wp/3-plan/sizing.py) writes it, tests/test_plan2_model_terms.py::PinnedFigures checks it.
